Peak Climber.description: Adapted to scaling vertical cliff faces and navigating treacherous frozen ledges with absolute sure-footedness.

features.name: Summit Grip
features.tldr: You gain a climbing speed equal to your walking speed, and difficult terrain made of ice or snow doesn't slow you down.

Glacial Warden.description: Trained to protect high-altitude passes from frost giants and avalanches, possessing extra defensive bulk.

features.name: Glacial Fortitude
features.tldr: Your maximum hit points increase by an amount equal to your character level, bolstering your frontline staying power.
